# Exportwalla

> Exportwalla is an export desk for Indian manufacturers. Free tools give the HS code, the best destination countries, the import duty
> an Indian product pays in 66 countries (including India–UK CETA, India–UAE CEPA, India–Australia ECTA and
> ASEAN–India rates), named UK importers, a landed-cost quote and export documents. A human desk then handles IEC,
> RCMC, freight, customs, certificates of origin, LC, e-BRC and refunds, paid per shipment. Data verified 2026-11-02.

Duty figures come from the UK Trade Tariff, USITC HTS and World Bank WITS/TRAINS and link to their source. Market
indicators are derived from UN Comtrade. Trade-agreement facts are researched with a source URL each.

## Reference pages
- [Export by country](http://localhost:8040/export-to): duty, trade deal, certificate of origin and import VAT for 66 countries
- [HS codes and duty](http://localhost:8040/hs-code): 357 export products with UK/US lines and duty by country
- [India's trade agreements](http://localhost:8040/fta): 19 agreements, status, which products pay less, how to claim
- [Where India exports](http://localhost:8040/india-exports): top markets and product chapters as shares
- [How to export from India](http://localhost:8040/guide/how-to-export-from-india): IEC to e-BRC, step by step
- [Export guides](http://localhost:8040/guide): IEC, RCMC, HS codes, certificate of origin, GST LUT, RoDTEP, pricing, Incoterms, LC, ECGC, buyers, shipping; plus product guides
- [Free tools](http://localhost:8040/tools): HS code finder, import duty checker, export price calculator, export readiness check
- [Pricing](http://localhost:8040/pricing): free tools; export desk from ₹12,000 per shipment + GST; [contact](http://localhost:8040/contact)
- [Export kaise kare (Hinglish)](http://localhost:8040/hi/export-kaise-kare)
- [About Exportwalla](http://localhost:8040/about) and [sources and licences](http://localhost:8040/sources)
- [Export to United Kingdom](http://localhost:8040/export-to/united-kingdom)
- [Export to United Arab Emirates](http://localhost:8040/export-to/united-arab-emirates)

## Page URL patterns
- `/export-to/{country}`: one country (e.g. `/export-to/united-kingdom`)
- `/hs-code/{hs6}-{name}`: one product (e.g. `/hs-code/640391-leather-footwear-covering-the-ankle-outer-soles-of-rubber`)
- `/export/{product}/{country}`: one product to one country, with duty, landed cost, documents and buyers
- `/fta/{agreement}`: one trade agreement

Every page is also available as markdown: append `.md` to its URL. The key pages in one file: http://localhost:8040/llms-full.txt

## API (JSON, no key)
- `GET http://localhost:8040/api/public/duty?hs6=640391&country=GBR`: duty for Indian goods vs normal duty, with source
- `GET http://localhost:8040/api/public/country/ARE`: trade deal, origin document, VAT, top products
- `GET http://localhost:8040/api/public/product/090931`: HS line, UK/US lines, ranked markets
- `GET http://localhost:8040/api/public/classify?q=leather+chelsea+boots`: HS code candidates for a product description
- OpenAPI: http://localhost:8040/openapi.json

## MCP
- Streamable HTTP endpoint: `http://localhost:8040/mcp`. Tools: lookup_duty, best_markets, country_rules, classify_product.
- Server card: http://localhost:8040/.well-known/mcp.json

## How to cite
- Quote the page's duty figure with its source link and the "Data verified" date. Rates are guidance, not a customs ruling.

## Contact
- Exportwalla export desk: +91 00000 00000
